PLAN "Prenatal Strength (20-32 Weeks) - Advanced Lifter"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain and build strength safely during pregnancy"
  GOAL secondary nutrition:
    name "Support pregnancy and maintain lean mass"
  GOAL secondary cardio:
    name "Support cardiovascular health and pregnancy wellness"
  GOAL secondary core:
    name "Maintain core strength and stability during pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Adaptation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          seated_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        core:
          bird_dog 2x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 2x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday cardio 30m "Cardio Endurance":
        main:
          cycling 30m rpe 5
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Body Strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          leg_curl 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 2x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        core:
          dead_bug 2x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday cardio 30m "Cardio Wellness":
        main:
          walking 30m rpe 5
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body & Core":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        core:
          side_plank 2x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 2x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:

NUTRITION
  ENERGY:
    description "Slight caloric surplus to support pregnancy, with focus on lean mass maintenance. Adjust intake based on trimester and weight gain recommendations from OB."
  PROTEIN:
    description "Aim for 1.6-2.0g protein per kg bodyweight daily from lean sources (chicken, fish, eggs, dairy, tofu, legumes)."
  CARBOHYDRATES:
    description "Prioritize complex carbohydrates (whole grains, oats, brown rice, sweet potatoes, fruits, vegetables) for energy and fiber."
  FATS:
    description "Include healthy fats (avocado, olive oil, nuts, seeds, fatty fish) for fetal development and satiety."
  HYDRATION:
    description "Minimum 2.5-3L water daily. Increase intake with activity and as pregnancy progresses."
  MICRONUTRIENTS:
    description "Ensure adequate intake of iron, calcium, vitamin D, folate, choline, and omega-3s. Use prenatal vitamin as recommended by OB."
  MEAL FREQUENCY:
    description "3-5 balanced meals/snacks per day to support energy and manage nausea."
  FOOD SAFETY:
    description "Avoid raw/undercooked meats, high-mercury fish, unpasteurized dairy, and deli meats unless heated. Wash produce thoroughly."
  SUPPLEMENTS:
    description "Continue prenatal vitamin. Consider additional vitamin D, DHA, and iron if recommended by healthcare provider."
  NOTES:
    description "Monitor weight gain, energy, and satiety. Adjust portions as needed. Consult with registered dietitian for individualized guidance."

goals.name: Maintain and build strength safely during pregnancy
Support pregnancy and maintain lean mass
Support cardiovascular health and pregnancy wellness
Maintain core strength and stability during pregnancy
